group_context: Six standalone satirical Roman legion military costume archetypes. No historical likeness, canonical deck mapping or inferred pair/trio relations.

figuren.name: Centurio Brüllus Maximus

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

accessoires: bronze helmet with transverse red crest
figuren.prompt_auszug: MALE-READ CENTURION. Very broad low barrel blob, huge thick side lobes, squat bronze helmet with short RED TRANSVERSE crest running ear-to-ear. Barking affront at peak breath: one eye compressed low, other wide and staring forward, violently unequal brows, skewed rectangular open mouth with three offset teeth and heavy lower lip. Holds ONE short thick GLADIUS upright low beside body, simple steel blade, round wooden grip visibly in hand. Red shoulder scrap and two modest bronze armor bands, no full human cuirass.

figuren.name: Optio Seitenblicka

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

accessoires: iron helmet with two red feathers
figuren.prompt_auszug: FEMALE-READ OPTIO. Tall slender hooked pear blob with looped crown lobe, modest iron helmet with two compact red side feathers, subtle lashes. Cool knowingly mischievous side-eye, one eyelid high, opposite lowered, closed crooked smile with single small offset upper tooth. One hand rests over a stout upright wooden STAFF with large round knob, other goo hand on own side. Staff stays alongside and within cell, not pointing at another actor. Small brown scale-armor shoulder panel.

figuren.name: Aquilifer Würdentrag

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: MALE-READ AQUILIFER / EAGLE STANDARD BEARER. Round top-heavy asymmetrical splat, a broad goofy bronze lion-face helmet cap with rounded clay ears, no furry creature anatomy. Deep sincere WORRY, eyes looking up at his own standard, inner brows lifted, sagging lip pinched into an anxious closed underbite with two lower teeth. Clutches ONE SHORT gold eagle standard against body: chunky simple eagle with two wings and a bent head perched on stubby thick pole. Not a long flagpole, no text. Weight of honor feels personally inconvenient.

figuren.name: Cornicen Pausius

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: MALE-READ CORNICEN / HORN SIGNALER. Tall bent kidney-shaped blob with a prominent downward side lobe, plain dull iron helmet and one small blue cloth neck scrap. Worn-out unimpressed expression, very heavy lowered white eyes looking sideways and enormous projecting pout, mouth almost closed with one tiny tooth. Holds ONE large rounded G-shaped BRONZE CORNU HORN across his own lower body, simple continuous circular tube with a clear flared bell and a single short crossbrace. Horn NOT played; free hand loosely cradles its bell. Whole horn inside cell. Not a repeated puff-cheek bugler.

figuren.name: Legionär Dienstus Zweifel

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: MALE-READ ORDINARY LEGIONARY. Short wide upright dumpling splat with three fat crown drops, dented simple iron helmet crooked over one eye, red neck fold. Absurd bewildered determination: huge white eyes peering DOWN around one large rounded lobe, one raised brow and one scrunched lid, tightly clenched uneven ivory teeth with raised lower lip. A rounded RED RECTANGULAR CURVED SCUTUM shield with bronze central boss is held close to one side, covers less than half his body; ONE shortened stout PILUM held vertically on other side, simple wooden shaft and steel tip within cell. The props seem almost too official for their nervous owner. Keep whole blob visible and footless.

figuren.name: Tribunin Aktena

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

accessoires: ornamental bronze helmet with ivory crest
figuren.prompt_auszug:
FEMALE-READ TRIBUNE. Broad upright wavy-edged diamond-shaped soft splat, two small curled upper lobes, ornamental bronze helmet with short swept-back IVORY crest, muted purple shoulder sash. Strained diplomatic politeness at its limit: unequal wide white eyes glancing sideways, brows lifted unequally, stretched very shallow crooked grin with two widely separated ivory teeth, tense cheek fold. Holds ONE small hinged wood-framed WAX TABLET open across her lower body and ONE fat short wooden STYLUS in the other hand. Wax plain, no marks/text. No full robes, human torso or legs.

Layout: six large complete self-contained actors in a visually regular 3x2 grid. Similar substantial BODY HEIGHT across both rows, clothing never replaces blob form. Each whole silhouette approx450-480px tall inside512px cell with safe transparent margins. Contain all crests, swords, staff, standard, horn, shield, pilum, tablet and droplets; no touching/overlap of neighboring actors. Do not make tiny bottom-row figures. No visible gridlines, scenery, floor, ground, shadow discs, background gradient, checkerboard, halos, text or watermark. Real transparent alpha-zero background and opaque character interiors, clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio lighting on character volumes only.
